name: 10592-batchdecode-8blora-1gpu
model: NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, bf16 -- the ungated mirror of meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct (same weights) and the `base_model_name_or_path` the served adapter declares; the Llama 3.1 Community License applies.
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, EP=1. One GPU, one server, no router and no external cache tier.
architecture: LlamaForCausalLM, 32 layers, GQA 32 query heads over 8 KV heads (head_dim 128), hidden 4096, intermediate 14336, vocab 128256, RoPE to 131072 positions, bf16, ~16.1 GB of weights; one LoRA adapter on top, `algoprog/fact-generation-llama-3.1-8b-instruct-lora`, r=64, alpha=16, dropout 0.1, on q_proj k_proj v_proj o_proj gate_proj.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=128, warmup the first 30%, bounded at 1000 requests with a 1800 s safety cap.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, no prefix buckets, seed 42; prompts 512 +- 128 tokens, generations 256 +- 32 tokens, `ignore_eos`; radix cache off, so every prompt is a real prefill.
purpose: A fact-generation assistant on an adapter-tuned 8-billion-parameter model, serving 128 concurrent half-page prompts on one GPU.
launch:
# Flat `key: value` only -- an indented block is skipped when this file is read.
model-path: NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct
tp-size: 1
lora-paths: ["lora=algoprog/fact-generation-llama-3.1-8b-instruct-lora"]
lora-backend: csgmv
disable-radix-cache: true
